skill.name: website-ci-gate
skill.description: Configure squirrelscan website audit checks for GitHub Actions, GitLab, and preview deployments. Use a baseline to set score thresholds or block new findings with a cloud audit.
skill.summary: Set up website audit gates using baseline scores, finding severity, or new findings.
skill.author: squirrelscan
skill.license: See LICENSE file in repository root

security_audit.summary: Both documented installers execute unverified remote code, and the CI examples can expose credentials to unverified dependencies. Preview URL trust and the first cloud audit's success without a baseline also need safeguards. Most other matches are Markdown syntax, reference links, or normal secret storage guidance.

remediation.issue: The local and CI install examples execute remote shell content without verification.
remediation.suggestion: Pin a CLI release and verify its signature or a trusted digest before running it. Run installation without secrets and invoke the verified binary by absolute path.

remediation.issue: The GitHub Actions example gives an optional organization token to a dependency pinned only by a mutable tag.
remediation.suggestion: Pin the reviewed action to a full commit SHA. Expose a least-privilege token only in trusted jobs that need cloud audit features.

remediation.issue: The preview workflow does not constrain the source or destination of the deployment URL.
remediation.suggestion: Accept URLs only from trusted deployment events. Enforce approved HTTPS hosts and restrict runner access to internal endpoints, including during redirects.

remediation.issue: The first cloud audit exits successfully without a comparison baseline.
remediation.suggestion: Seed and verify an approved baseline for the intended website ID before requiring the new-findings check. Treat missing baselines as incomplete checks.

content.user_title: Gate Website Releases With Audit Checks
content.value_statement: Website regressions can reach production when audits are manual. Use a baseline audit to set CI thresholds and check staging sites or preview deployments.
actual_capabilities: Run a quick baseline audit and recommend thresholds the site currently meets.
Set gates for overall scores, category scores, errors, or warnings.
Configure a cloud comparison to fail on new findings at a chosen severity.
Draft GitHub Actions and GitLab CI workflows and show the diff before editing.
Schedule preview audits after deployment and distinguish threshold failures from operational errors.
limitations: Requires a configured squirrelscan tool and a website reachable by the audit environment.
Reports problems but does not fix them.
Comparing new findings requires an organization API key, a website ID, and a prior cloud audit.
A targeted rule set produces a partial score that cannot be compared with a full audit.

use_cases.title: Set a Staging Score Floor
use_cases.description: Measure the staging baseline and choose an overall score threshold that the current site meets.

use_cases.title: Check Preview Deployments
use_cases.description: Draft a CI check that audits previews from a trusted deployment integration after they become reachable.

use_cases.title: Block New Audit Errors
use_cases.description: Plan a cloud comparison that blocks new errors without blocking releases for existing findings.

prompt_templates.title: Measure a Baseline
prompt_templates.scenario: First audit of an authorized staging site
prompt_templates.prompt: Use my existing verified squirrel CLI to run a quick offline audit of our staging URL. Summarize the scores and findings without changing CI.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a Score Gate
prompt_templates.scenario: Staging site with a measured baseline
prompt_templates.prompt: Use our staging baseline to propose a GitHub Actions score gate. Show the workflow diff before editing, and use a reviewed action pinned to a commit.

prompt_templates.title: Add a Preview Check
prompt_templates.scenario: GitLab pipeline with a preview deployment job
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft a GitLab audit job that waits for the preview deployment. Require an approved preview host and fail the check on any nonzero audit exit.

prompt_templates.title: Gate Only New Errors
prompt_templates.scenario: Existing findings tracked in an approved cloud audit
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft a cloud gate that fails on new errors for our website ID. Require an approved baseline first and reference an existing, scoped CI secret.

output_examples.input: Recommend a score floor for a staging site with a baseline score of 89.
output_examples.output: Set the initial floor at 85. The baseline score of 89 passes. Verify the threshold in CI before making the check required.

output_examples.input: Explain why our preview check failed with exit status 5.
output_examples.output: The preview URL was unreachable, so no pages were audited. Keep the check failed and verify that the preview is ready and reachable.

output_examples.input: Decide whether to enforce the new-errors check after the first cloud audit.
output_examples.output: The first audit returned success without a comparison. Confirm the approved baseline and website ID, then test the check before making it required.

best_practices: Choose thresholds from a recent baseline measured with the same audit settings used in CI.
Use a verified CLI release or a reviewed action pinned to a full commit SHA.
Keep cloud keys in CI secrets and give them only the scopes and job access the audit needs.
anti_patterns: Running an installer directly from a network response.
Treating an unreachable, blocked, or redirected audit as a passing check.
Comparing a partial audit score with a full audit baseline.

faq.question: Do I need an API key?
faq.answer: No for local, signed-out audits. Cloud comparisons for new findings need an organization key with audit read and write scopes.

faq.question: Can I fail a build for a single audit error?
faq.answer: Yes. Set the gate to fail when it finds any error-severity issue.

faq.question: What happens on the first new-findings audit?
faq.answer: It exits successfully without a comparison. Verify that the approved baseline exists before relying on the gate.

faq.question: Does a threshold detect every score drop?
faq.answer: No. A score threshold checks a fixed minimum. A drop that remains above that minimum does not fail the gate.

faq.question: Can I use this with GitLab CI?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill describes a CLI-based GitLab job. Use a verified CLI release and configure any required key as a CI secret.

faq.question: Will the skill fix audit findings?
faq.answer: No. It configures CI and explains gate failures. Fixing the underlying findings is separate work.
